ns2:course.label: Leadership Laboratory
ns2:course.description: Advanced level practical application of military skills and leadership with emphasis on the student's ability to direct and supervise others; includes advanced land navigation, advanced first aid, platoon and company drill and ceremonies, and advanced communications procedures. Field trip required. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: For third-year military science students. Field trips required.
